'''Uniqueness''' limits copies of a card in ''[[Star Wars CCG]]''. Dots (•) and diamonds (◊) before a card title set different limits.<ref name="ar23">[[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Star Wars CCG Advanced Rulebook]], Players Committee (2023), pp. 49 and 75. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192915id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive]. [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

== Dots ==
A card with one dot is unique. A card with two or more dots is restricted. The dot count limits how many copies can be on the table. It also limits how many cards of that title and persona can be played or deployed each turn. A canceled attempt still counts toward the turn limit. The same title limit applies to copies on both sides of the Force, as with [[Ice Storm]]. A title with neither dots nor diamonds has no copy limit under this rule.<ref name="ar23" /><ref name="gl20">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 134–135. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

Cards with different titles can represent the same [[Persona|persona]]. Persona rules generally limit each player to one version of a unique persona on the table. The card title limit also applies when a persona is available to both sides.<ref name="ar23" />

== Diamonds ==
The number of diamonds limits the copies both players may have at each system, including its related locations. Three diamonds on [[Asteroid Field]] allow three copies total at each planet system. The limit applies separately at each system.<ref name="gl20" /><ref name="ar23" />

[[Trade Federation Droid Control Ship]] was the first diamond-restricted starship. The [[Players Committee]] rule for one-diamond starships applies to both deployment and movement. A copy cannot deploy or move to the same location as another copy, or to a location at the same system as that copy.<ref name="cor">[[Media:Decipher Coruscant Rulesheet.pdf|Coruscant expansion rules]], Decipher (2001), Rule Card 2A of 3, “Starships With ◊ Uniqueness”. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070203201646id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/coruscantrules.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="ar23" />
